function.name: set_promise_to_pay
function.description: Use this tool when the consumer cannot pay right now but verbally commits to paying a specific amount by a specific date. Do NOT call this if the consumer is vague ('I'll try to pay soon') or has not committed to a date and amount.

amount.description: The dollar amount the consumer commits to paying (e.g., 94.50)

date.description: The date the consumer promises to pay by, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-10-01')

messages.content: Let me note that arrangement on your account.
